name: GIRDER 格拉德 Glare rim-brake Ultegra R8000
why_interesting: GIRDER's only official rim-brake road bike: a T700 + T800 BB386 quick-release endurance frame with mechanical Ultegra R8000 2×11 and alloy wheels on 25C tires at ¥7,200.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra R8000 mechanical 2×11; FC-R8000 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R8000 11-32T cassette; chain not listed
facts.brakes: Shimano Ultegra R8000 rim caliper brakes
facts.frame: ROAD-section GLARE T700 + T800 carbon endurance frame and fork, quick-release dropouts, fully internal routing
facts.frame_material: T700 + T800 carbon frame and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded rim-brake endurance frame and fork with internal routing and press-fit bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: BB386 press-fit system, 46 mm × 86 mm per the manufacturer's BB row
facts.wheels: Aluminium rims, 20-hole front / 24-hole rear, quick-release straight-pull bearing hubs
facts.tires: CST C-1406 700C×25C skinwall fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: T700 + T800 integrated carbon handlebar with internal routing
facts.sizes: 440 mm, 470 mm, 500 mm, 530 mm; the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
